description: This file contains a base class for managing a test cluster in Orleans testing framework, along with extension methods for serialization, deep copying, and retrieving serializers, specifically tailored for testing infrastructure.

classes.name: HostedTestClusterEnsureDefaultStarted
classes.description: An abstract base class that manages starting a default Orleans silo cluster for testing, avoiding redundant restarts.

methods.name: RoundTripSystemTextJsonSerialization
methods.description: Serializes and deserializes a value using System.Text.Json to test round-trip serialization.

methods.name: RoundTripSerializationForTesting
methods.description: Serializes and deserializes a value using Orleans Serializer for testing purposes.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a value using Orleans DeepCopier.

methods.name: GetSerializer
methods.description: Retrieves the Orleans Serializer from the service provider.
